defect: ALU vector AND operation uses a logical operator
rationale: The logical && operation reduces two 32-bit operands to one Boolean bit before assigning result_o, so an ALU AND result loses 31 data bits.

mutation.description: Replaced the vector AND operator in the ALU datapath with logical &&.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the ALU to a two-bit operation selector with AND, OR, and default results.

labels.note: logical && on 32-bit operands yields 1-bit result, not bitwise AND
